title: How Five-Star Hotels Make Money | The Business Behind Luxury Hotels | The Business Vault
description:
How do Five-Star Hotels actually make money? Is a ₹20,000 hotel room really their biggest source of revenue?
In this documentary, we break down the business behind Five-Star Hotels and discover how luxury hotels turn rooms, restaurants, spas, weddings, corporate events, and other services into multiple revenue streams.
We’ll follow a hypothetical ₹500 crore luxury hotel with 300 rooms and explore everything from hotel occupancy, room pricing, dynamic pricing, Revenue Management and RevPAR to the hidden costs of running a Five-Star Property.
You’ll also learn how Hilton, Marriott and other major hotel groups use franchise and management contracts, why the asset-light hotel business model is so powerful, and how Brand Trust influences customer spending.
But high revenue doesn't always mean high profit. Payroll, food costs, electricity, maintenance, marketing, technology, commissions, financing and capital expenditure can dramatically affect a hotel's profitability.
From hotel revenue and occupancy to hotel profit margins and business strategy, this video explains how the luxury hospitality industry really works.
If you enjoy business documentaries, hotel business models, finance, economics and how companies make money, this video is for you.
